shortBulletSummary: Hot US inflation data intensifies Federal Reserve rate hike fears, impacting crypto markets negatively.
Bitcoin dips below $74,000 as crypto ETFs see over $1 billion in outflows and futures liquidations exceed $900 million.
Vitalik Buterin labels ETH a store of value, while major L2 projects return to Layer 1 due to mainnet performance improvements.
Charles Schwab expands trading to Solana, Avalanche, and Chainlink as institutional interest in asset tokenization grows.
